scope: Cross-check existing 7G.3d against official format descriptions, current code, and open-source peers; refine implementation readiness without promoting support claims.

method.kind: Official specification and DXF reference review, peer documentation/source review, local read-only code inspection
method.evidenceRule: ODA v5.4.1 governs documented DWG layout; Autodesk governs published DXF tags. Peer schemas and reports identify fields and tests but are not normative or semantic oracles.

evidence.topic: Versioned TABLE and TABLECONTENT DWG representation
evidence.observed: ODA §§20.4.96–20.4.101 distinguish TABLE's INSERT/*T geometry block from cell semantics, separate legacy layout through R21 from R24 content, describe R21 multi-content/linked content and R24 embedded DWG content, and leave some linkage details TODO.
evidence.planUse: Keep AC1021 and AC1024+ lanes distinct; require an eligible sample trace before DWG binary edits.

evidence.topic: Published DXF TABLE and TABLESTYLE tags
evidence.observed: The references document context-sensitive repeated 91/92, cell type/edge/merge/autofit/span/virtual-edge values, legacy and 2007+ text sequences, FIELD and block-cell references, table-level overrides, and TABLESTYLE suppression/repeated cell styles.
doesNotEstablish: that every content type is represented by the local model
evidence.planUse: Use a bounded phase-aware parser, generated field-level ASCII/binary cases, and staged reference remapping.

evidence.observed: The adapter retains the typed TABLE snapshot and current INSERT fallback. The model has cell type, merge/span/content/style fields; parseCode currently maps 171 to flags and discards repeated per-cell 172–178/91/92; writeTable emits defaults and directly emits a nonzero style handle. No dedicated TABLESTYLE writer was found in the reviewed path.
doesNotEstablish: which future public fields may be required
evidence.planUse: Correct parse mapping before public model expansion; stage graph handles and prevent duplicate semantic/fallback output.

evidence.observed: LibreDWG supplies a rich field inventory; ACadSharp reports partial table reads and separates undocumented BOM classes; ezdxf lacks native ACAD_TABLE xref support and offers a primitive painter; CADCraft's suppression/merge helper is ACadRust-derived.
doesNotEstablish: multiple independent votes from related implementations
evidence.planUse: Use schemas as inventories and reports as test leads only, with lineages recorded.

evidence.topic: Aggregate peer coverage versus per-feature evidence
evidence.observed: LibreDWG describes aggregate DWG-to-DXF and DXF-to-DWG coverage percentages, while its current README also documents writer version limits. Those aggregate route statements do not identify ACAD_TABLE field, owner, version, or semantic coverage.
doesNotEstablish: a per-entity or per-field support matrix
evidence.planUse: Keep parity claims scoped by entity, field, direction, version, ownership and external acceptance rather than peer-wide percentages.

evidence.topic: LibreCAD consumer and downstream write boundary
evidence.observed: LibreCAD identifies its in-tree fork as the maintained DWG read/write copy and says its top-level build is the primary in-tree test path; LibreCAD_3 documents read-only DWG import and a ledger with 15 read claims, no promoted claims and no write claims.
doesNotEstablish: compatibility of unpinned upstream source changes with either downstream project
runtime or native consumer qualification from compile checks
evidence.planUse: Keep consumer source reconciliation and compile gates distinct from native behavior and directional format qualification.

implementationReadinessChanges: Refine existing 7G.3d; add no finding or top-level subplan.
Sequence DXF parse first, then DXF TABLE/TABLESTYLE output and graph remapping, then versioned sample-traced DWG handling, then one composed visual/consumer check.
Reuse existing adapter tests and fast checks; keep full suites, external peers, sanitizers and native CAD at composed checkpoints.
Use locally authored in-memory controls only; do not download or check in drawing fixtures.
